sources.title: Webhook

events.title: Catch Hook
events.description: When the webhook URL receives a GET, POST, or PUT request

settings.title: Verification handshake response
settings.description: Set this when the sender verifies the URL before delivering events (for example Slack Event Subscriptions, Feishu/Lark, Meta, Microsoft Graph, Dropbox); look up the sender's documentation. An expr-lang expression over method, query, headers (lower-case names), body (decoded JSON or form) and text (raw body). Return nil for ordinary deliveries, or a map {status (200-299, default 200), content_type ("application/json" or "text/plain"), headers (map, at most 8; only X- custom headers, Allow, WebHook-Allowed-Origin, WebHook-Allowed-Rate), body (string or JSON value)}. A matching request gets the response, needs no bearer token and does not start a run; later real events still need the bearer token when authentication is on, so turn authentication off when the sender cannot set an Authorization header (Slack, Feishu, Meta, Dropbox, Graph). Slack: type(body) == "map" && body.type == "url_verification" ? {body: {challenge: body.challenge}} : nil

settings.title: Merge requests
settings.description: Turn on to merge a burst of matched requests (for example several short chat messages) into one run. The run receives every merged request in arrival order: {{payload}} becomes a JSON array of {received_at, payload} and the input attachment holds the complete requests. A single request is delivered unchanged. Off by default: each request is delivered at once and the other merge settings are kept but ignored.

settings.title: Merge idle time (seconds)
settings.description: With merging on: the run starts once a group receives no new matched request for this many seconds; each new matched request restarts the wait. Defaults to 5.

settings.title: Merge maximum wait (seconds)
settings.description: With merging on: the longest time the first request of a group waits before the run starts, even when requests keep arriving. Defaults to 60 and is at least the idle time. Set it equal to the idle time to deliver at most one run per period (throttling).

settings.title: Merge group by
settings.description: With merging on: an expr-lang expression over method, query, headers (only the stored content-type, user-agent, accept, x-request-id and idempotency-key), body (decoded JSON or form) and text (raw body) whose value names the group a request merges into. Requests merge only with the same value; omit to merge the whole entry as one group. A nil value or an evaluation error delivers that request on its own. Slack threads: [body.event?.channel, body.event?.thread_ts ?? ""]
